headline: Names a Postal Service facility in Hardin, Texas, the "Lucas Lowe Memorial Post Office."
what_it_does: This law renames the United States Postal Service building at 11158 Highway 146 North in Hardin, Texas. The new official name is the "Lucas Lowe Memorial Post Office." It does not change mail service, postal rules, or how the office operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on August 23, 2019, and the renaming took effect on that date.
